in_marathi.name: Bhaveshan
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the Sky
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bhaveshan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Bhaveshan is derived from Bhava + Isha, where Bhava means 'Sky' and Isha means 'Lord'.

in_bengali.long_meaning: Bhaveshan একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Bhaveshan is derived from Bhava + Isha, where Bhava means 'Sky' and Isha means 'Lord'.
